Ashwagandha Root Extract

Remedy ashwagandha adaptogen stress cortisol thyroid

Evidence: scientific

Adaptogenic herb that helps the body manage stress, supports thyroid function, and reduces cortisol levels.

Treats These Ailments

Conditions listed as treatable by this remedy:

  • Adrenal Fatigue
    Hypothalamic-pituitary-adrenal axis dysfunction leading to chronic fatigue and stress intolerance.
  • Histamine Intolerance
    Inability to properly break down histamine leading to allergy-like symptoms.
  • Blood Sugar Imbalance
    Imbalances in blood sugar regulation, including hyperglycemia and hypoglycemia.
  • Immune System Weakness
    Weakened immune system leading to frequent infections and slow recovery.
  • Thyroid Dysfunction
    Underactive or overactive thyroid gland leading to hormonal imbalance and metabolic issues.
  • Menopause Transition
    Hormonal changes during the menopausal transition causing various symptoms.
  • Hair Loss
    Excessive hair loss due to nutritional deficiencies, hormonal imbalance, or autoimmune conditions.
  • Restless Leg Syndrome
    Uncontrollable urge to move legs, usually due to uncomfortable sensations.
  • Tinnitus
    Perception of noise or ringing in the ears when no external sound is present.
  • Menopause
    Natural biological process marking the end of menstrual cycles and fertility in women.
  • Prostatitis
    Inflammation of the prostate gland, often causing pain and urinary symptoms.
